definitions.explanation: The crime of stealing property from someone.

examples.japanese: {車|くるま}の{盗難|とうなん}に{遭|あ}った。
{盗難|とうなん}{届|とどけ}を{出|だ}す。
examples.english: I will file a theft report.

examples.japanese: {盗難|とうなん}{防止|ぼうし}のため{鍵|かぎ}をかける。
examples.english: I lock up to prevent theft.

notes:
{盗難|とうなん} refers to theft or being a victim of theft.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {盗難|とうなん}に{遭|あ}う: to be robbed, to have something stolen
- {盗難|とうなん}{届|とどけ}: theft report
- {盗難|とうなん}{防止|ぼうし}: theft prevention
- {盗難|とうなん}{保険|ほけん}: theft insurance
- {盗難|とうなん}{車|しゃ}: stolen vehicle

RELATED WORDS:
- {窃盗|せっとう}: theft, larceny
- {強盗|ごうとう}: robbery
- {被害|ひがい}: damage, harm
